method: Static current-main manifest/entrypoint, compiled-plan, roster and effective-pack inventory. In-progress local context work is a separate dependency; historical test results are not revalidated here.

knownDifferences.text: US law has no general PEP screening requirement outside private banking for senior foreign political figures (31 CFR 1010.620); PEP screening comes from the institution layer.

UK law says more than 25 percent; the library's UBO skill counts 25 percent or more. An owner of exactly 25 percent is therefore treated as a beneficial owner: stricter than the regulation, never looser.

OFSI does not aggregate the holdings of different designated persons; the library's ofac_50_percent rule does. Aggregation flags more entities than the UK test: stricter, never looser. A UK-specific rule needs a library change.
